title: Deputy Director of Launch Production (Job ID:4696)
text:
**Deputy Director of Launch Production**

**Purpose:**

* Valkyrie Enterprises is seeking a **Deputy Director of Launch Production** in **Huntsville, AL**, to oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of launch production programs in support of Department of War (DoW) customers.

**Job Description:**

* Manage all aspects of launch production programs, including technical performance, cost, schedule, contract requirements, and program deliverables.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, and support services, to ensure successful program execution.
* Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, budgets, and performance metrics to ensure program milestones and customer requirements are met.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing regular updates on program performance, schedules, risks, and deliverables.
* Monitor program performance, identify potential risks, and implement corrective actions to ensure successful execution within established budgets and timelines.
* Support the development and implementation of a 5-year strategic plan for launcher and launch services across the DoW, including ground-based, sea-based, and air-launched capabilities.
* Support business development and capture activities, including identifying new opportunities, developing proposals, and supporting FAR-based contracts, Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs), and task orders.
* Manage program financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and profitability.
* Work closely with company leadership to align program objectives with customer requirements and organizational goals.
* Provide leadership and oversight of program personnel, including staffing, resource planning, and team performance.

**Qualifications:**

* Must have a Bachelor's Degree in a STEM field and at least 20 years of relevant experience supporting DoW programs or projects.
* Must have demonstrated experience managing complex defense programs, including cost, schedule, technical performance, and contract execution.
* Must have experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating technical, manufacturing, and production activities.
* Must have experience managing program budgets, financial performance, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Must have experience executing government contracts, including FAR-based contracts, OTAs, and task orders.
* Must have demonstrated experience managing customer relationships and ensuring successful delivery of contractual requirements.
* Must have experience supporting business development, proposal development, and capture efforts.
* Must have demonstrated leadership experience, including personnel management, staffing, and organizational growth.
* Must be a self-starter with strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Must have strong oral and written communication skills.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
* Experience managing missile, launcher, or defense production programs preferred.
* Top Secret/SCI security clearance preferred.

**Security Requirements:**

* Must have an Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain the clearance.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Travel – 25%.
* If position requires travel by domestic flight or access to secure federal facilities/military bases, candidate must be able to obtain (by start of position) and maintain appropriate identification credentials, such as REAL ID. (More information regarding REAL ID can be found: https://www.dhs.gov/real-id)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
* Able to sit and work on a computer for long periods of time.
* Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another.
* Communicating with others to exchange information.
* Light work that includes moving objects up to 20 pounds.

**Pre-Employment Requirements:**

Any offer of employment with Valkyrie Enterprises is contingent upon the successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements. Depending on the position, these may include a criminal background investigation, employment and education verification, pre-employment drug screening, driving record review, security clearance eligibility, government installation access, and any other customer or contract-specific requirements. Failure to successfully meet any required pre-employment condition may result in the withdrawal of the contingent offer of employment.

**Valkyrie strictly adheres to a policy of equal employment opportunity. This policy is based on Valkyrie’s commitment to hire and retain qualified employees consistent with position requirements; and to seek, employ, promote and treat all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental disability, age, military status or protected veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition, genetic information or sexual orientation or other protected characteristics.**

Additionally, Valkyrie Enterprises provides a variety of benefits to eligible employees to support your best health, wellness, and future, to include medical/dental/vision options, company paid life and disability insurances, 401k with match, education reimbursement, as well as company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).
